name: ocr97_night_1_irs_forms_gauntlet
description: Night 1: IRS forms gauntlet. Stresses the forms_or_checkboxes routing path — gb10_qwen_ocr primary, rapidocr fallback. Tests checkbox detection, field label extraction, multi-section layouts, and financial table parsing across documents significantly harder than the W-4.

documents.title: IRS Form 1040 (2024) — U.S. Individual Income Tax Return
documents.license_note: Public IRS form, no copyright restrictions.
documents.goal: Extract a complex multi-section tax form with numbered lines, dollar fields, filing status checkboxes, signature area, and tabular income/deduction sections.

documents.title: IRS Schedule D (2024) — Capital Gains and Losses
documents.goal: Extract a financial table form tracking capital gains and losses with multi-column Part I (short-term) and Part II (long-term) sections, date columns, and gain/loss totals.

documents.title: IRS Form W-9 — Request for Taxpayer Identification Number
documents.goal: Extract a government form with entity-type checkboxes, TIN fields, certification/signature section, and a dense instruction block.

documents.title: IRS Form 1099-B — Proceeds From Broker and Barter Exchange Transactions
documents.goal: Extract a multi-box tax form with financial fields for broker proceeds, cost basis, FATCA indicator checkbox, and accrued market discount. Tests dense small-type form parsing.

documents.title: IRS Form 8949 — Sales and Other Dispositions of Capital Assets
documents.goal: Extract a brokerage-style financial table with Part I and Part II sections for short-term and long-term capital asset dispositions. Tests dense row/column table OCR with numeric fields.
